title: Faster photos and smoother menus
details: Keeps the current camera, video prompts, timestamps, evidence saving and course structure unchanged
Photo capture now uses a faster evidence-sized image encode so the captured image appears much sooner
Course menu pages now fade smoothly out and back in when moving between them
The full-screen photo and video camera layout is unchanged
No Property Maintenance tiles, evidence records, navigation structure or other Evia behaviour was changed
summary: Evia v140 speeds photo capture and adds smooth menu fades without changing the approved workflow.
changes: Moved the offline shell to v140
